name: Jean Baudrillard
shortBio: French sociologist and cultural theorist of postmodernity. Formulated the concepts of simulacra, hyperreality, and the precession of models over the real in late consumer society.
centralQuestion: In a media-saturated world where signs refer only to other signs, does reality still exist, or has hyperreality replaced the real?

keyWorks.title: Simulacra and Simulation
keyWorks.description: Seminal philosophical treatise exploring the replacement of reality with signs and symbols (hyperreality), famously identifying four successive phases of the image.

keyWorks.title: The Consumer Society: Myths and Structures
keyWorks.description: Sociological and semiotic critique of late capitalism where commodities are consumed not for their use-value or exchange-value, but for their sign-value within social hierarchies.

keyWorks.title: The System of Objects
keyWorks.description: Pioneering semiotic analysis demonstrating how everyday consumer objects function primarily as an articulated language of signs rather than functional tools.
